name: REFLEXIA Prototype ver.
source:
The protagonist spends her days cooped up inside, sinking countless hours into eroges. She would've ended up bored to death eventually, if one day she wasn't teleported into a visual novel!

Of course, something like this isn't exactly a good situation for the young lady. Not only will you be privy to all of her shameful thoughts, you'd also demand entertainment from her. Isn't that why you came to read this story?

Seems like she will now, at the very least, need to go outside to buy groceries... Because no matter where she goes, the plot will await her!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1997680/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
主角整天把自己关在里面，无数个小时沉浸在游戏中。如果有一天她没有被传送到一本视觉小说中，她最终会无聊死的！

当然，这样的事情对于这位小姐来说并不是什么好事情。你不仅会知道她所有可耻的想法，还会要求她娱乐。这不就是你来看这个故事的原因吗？

看来她现在至少需要出去买菜了……因为无论她走到哪里，剧情都会等着她！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1997680/]Steam[/url]]
